name: airbrake_sourcemaps
description: Airbrake source maps: list, get, delete. sourcemap_id MUST be passed as a string. Upload (POST) is multipart/form-data and not modeled here; use airbrake_request with a pre-formed multipart body and matching Content-Type. List results include `_pagination.has_more`/`next_page`. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed unless list is given `fields` (keeps only those top-level keys per item).

fields.description: List actions only: keep just these top-level keys (exact names as Airbrake returns them, e.g. ["id","createdAt"]) on each listed item. Omit for the full payload.
